title: VBLS — Supplementary Materials
description: Supplementary materials for the VBLS monograph: Viability Boundaries of Living Systems — A Phenomenological Thermodynamic Theory. Includes (1) reproducibility scripts and data for the empirical verification program (human lifespan calibration, cross-species allometric scaling, telomere shortening, somatic mutation accumulation, VO2max decline, fish growth dynamics), (2) a machine-checked Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization of the central finite-lifetime theorem, (3) a bilingual FAQ, and (4) an interactive HTML classification table of living structures (Appendix C).
